_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 8 OF ~10: THE COURIER.
A courier is carrying orders through the site. Catch her, read the orders on the site's own terminal, and meet what
they said was coming: it comes in pods. The verb is INTERCEPT.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded) on his ruling, so the
lint pool is EMPTY on military sites until the markers are on them (missionboard06a's note says why).
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Intercept: Courier's Orders on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A courier is carrying the occupiers' orders through the <Place>. Whatever they say is coming hasn't arrived yet.
prose.card: Intercept contract. A courier is moving orders through the <Place> on <Planet>. Intercept her and recover the orders' contents. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The courier at the <Place> is dead. Her orders are coded for the site's own terminal.
say: That's her. Her orders will be coded, but their terminal can read them if you can get to it.

beats.journal: The orders were for reinforcements, landing at the entrance, on the hour. It's nearly the hour.
beats.name: Site Terminal
say: The orders say reinforcements, at the door, on the hour. Be at the door when they arrive.

beats.objective: Meet the reinforcements at the entrance
beats.journal: I caught the courier at the <Place>, read her orders, and was waiting at the door when the reinforcements they promised came down.
say: That was all of them. The orders were right.

broadcast: Their courier's going through there with orders. Stop her, and find out what they say. Whatever's coming, I'd rather you were ready for it.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
